name: Ollama API (OpenAI-Compatible, API Key)
description: Private Ollama LLM server with an OpenAI-compatible API behind an API key.

OLLAMA_API_KEY.description: API key clients send as 'Authorization: Bearer {key}' (or x-api-key). 24-256 chars.

API_BASE_URL.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL to paste into clients (informational).

PORT.description: Gateway port; the public domain points here.

OLLAMA_PULL_MODELS.description: Models pulled at start when missing (comma-separated): a 1 GB chat model and an embedding model.

OLLAMA_NUM_THREAD.description: Optional CPU threads for inference. Empty: this service's CPU quota, at most 8.

OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH.description: Default context window (tokens) for requests that do not set one.

OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE.description: Unload a model after this idle time to free RAM (e.g. 5m, 1h, -1 = never).

OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS.description: Models kept in RAM at once (chat + embeddings).

OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL.description: Requests one model handles at once; more needs more RAM and CPU.

OLLAMA_FLASH_ATTENTION.description: Flash attention, needed for the quantized KV cache.

OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE.description: 8-bit KV cache: about half the context memory, little quality loss.

OLLAMA_ORIGINS.description: Browser origins Ollama answers (CORS). The gateway still requires the API key.

OLLAMA_HOST.description: Bind address (IPv4 + IPv6), private network only.
